attchmntText: Gyftr Limited has informed the Exchange regarding change in Corporate Office of the company.
voiceSummary: Gyftr Limited approved un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of 12,478.30 lakh and a profit after tax of 221.46 lakh. The statutory auditor issued a qualified conclusion due to pending litigation involving borrowings from Kingfisher Airlines Limited and United Breweries Holdings Limited. A garnishee order for 2,500 lakhs is under challenge at the Debt Recovery Appellate Tribunal, Chennai. The company also approved a change in its corporate office address to 200, 2nd Floor, Best Sky Tower, Netaji Subhash Place, New Delhi. Additionally, the board approved a draft notice of postal ballot to seek shareholder approval for material related party transactions. M/s Abhay K & Associates were appointed as the scrutinizer for the postal ballot process.
